summary_en: ASR program adjustment settlement completed. Final net acquisition 3,322,100 shares via ToSTNeT-3 on 2025-11-25 and price-adjustment derivatives. Total acquisition cost ¥9,999,743,900 (unchanged). Average adjustment price ¥3,011.90/share (99.85% of 2025-11-26 to 2026-06-01 VWAP average). Daiwa Securities warrant exercise reduced repurchase by 64,200 shares, offset by warrant issuance.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Adjustment Trading in Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) Program
translation_en_brief: On 2 June 2026, Calbee announced completion of the price-adjustment phase of its Accelerated Share Repurchase (ASR) program initiated on 25 November 2025. The company executed a ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange buyback on 25 November 2025, acquiring 3,386,300 shares (including 100,000 shares from sellers other than Daiwa Securities) for ¥9,999,743,900. Under the ASR mechanics, Daiwa Securities simultaneously issued warrants (新株予約権) to hedge the forward share obligation. Between 26 November 2025 and 1 June 2026, the average stock price (simple average of daily VWAP) was ¥3,011.90 per share (calculated as 99.85% of the VWAP average). Following Daiwa's warrant exercise on 2 June 2026, the adjustment settlement reduced the final net repurchase to 3,322,100 shares: the initial 3,286,300 shares bought from Daiwa on 25 November were reduced by 64,200 shares delivered to Daiwa as warrant settlement. The total acquisition cost remains ¥9,999,743,900 and is unchanged by the adjustment.
